description: Models for br06 Row, Row, Row Your Boat (baby rhymes): a little rowing boat with two oars that sweep together. Same format as ../models.json. The river itself is shapes in the script (a long water plate with sandy edges and flow dots).

rowing_boat.description: A little rowing boat built along z (bow at +z): a round hull in its main colour (default red; set color) 2.5 m long, 1 m wide and 0.4 m tall (open, a white rim), a wooden middle seat (top at y 0.33) and a stern seat, and two oars on yellow-tipped oarlocks at the middle seat. Give it rotation [0, 90, 0] to row toward +x. Named part oar (both oars, mirror images): turn <id>#oar by [0, 30, 0] / [0, -30, 0] in turn to row (both blades sweep the same way); add a z offset (+8) to lift the blades on the way back. At rest the blades touch y 0 with the boat at y 0, so float it at about y -0.12. Robo sits in it on the middle seat (parent: the boat, at [0, 0.12, 0], Sitting clip).
